approval_ref: The active goal requires lightweight, local and verifiable page selection that reduces unnecessary advanced-model input while CIRP preserves task and version identity.
notes: Freeze one supported page-selector version on every Reference evaluation instead of silently changing an existing task's model input after an upgrade.
Backfill existing evaluations to literal-page-selector-3 and retain its six-page default; new evaluations use literal-page-selector-4 with a four-page default.
Use the frozen selector for preview, initial and supplemental evidence, managed execution, readiness, scorecards and same-snapshot comparisons.
Preserve the existing 48,000-byte selection bound and 18,000-byte serialized model-evidence bound; do not add semantic preprocessing, embeddings or model calls.

Verified the four-page policy against the same fixed 15-question page-identity fixture: 15/15 expected source pages remained selected, page references fell from 90 to 60, selected text fell from 523,245 to 350,827 bytes and provider-call count stayed unchanged at 5,743.
Validated with 58 focused Python contract/UI tests, 24 localization tests, JavaScript syntax checks and the complete 1,522-test Python suite.
The stronger-model answer benchmark remains separate: this task proves local input routing and historical reproducibility, not answer quality.
title: Freeze Reference selector versions and reduce new-task page scope
acceptance_tests: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/app/test_page_selector.py tests/app/test_evidence_loop.py tests/app/test_reference_evaluations.py tests/app/test_reference_readiness.py tests/app/test_reference_evaluation_jobs.py tests/app/test_reference_scorecards.py tests/web/test_display_contract.py -q
objective: Reduce new Reference tasks from six selected pages to four while preserving the fixed 15-question source-page gate and freezing the selector version so historical task inputs remain reproducible.
